question: Which techniques in tactic TA0002 are mitigated by M1038?

answer.headline: Gathered 9 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: The mitigation M1038 (Execution Prevention) mitigates 9 techniques under the TA0002 (Execution) tactic, including T1127 (Trusted Developer Utilities Proxy Execution), T1047 (Windows Management Instrumentation), and T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter).

claims.text: Found 9 ATT&CK record(s) including T1127, T1047, T1129 and more.

task.text: Which techniques under tactic TA0002 are mitigated by mitigation M1038?

results.sub_question: Which techniques under tactic TA0002 are mitigated by mitigation M1038?
results.query: MATCH (ta:Tactic)-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]->(t:Technique) WHERE ta.attack_id IN $tactic_ids MATCH (t)<-[:MITIGATES]-(m:Mitigation) WHERE m.attack_id IN $mitigation_ids RETURN ta.attack_id AS tactic_id, ta.name AS tactic_name, t.attack_id AS technique_id, t.name AS technique_name, m.attack_id AS mitigation_id, m.name AS mitigation_name LIMIT 300
results.summary: Found 9 ATT&CK record(s) including T1127, T1047, T1129 and more.
